caption: The drawing depicts a small, round table with a dark reddish-brown wooden color. The table has an oval-shaped top with a smooth surface, supported by a single, central, turned pedestal. The pedestal extends downward and branches into three curved legs, each leg spreading outward evenly from the center for balance. The table and its components appear centered on a plain, light beige background. There is a shadow beneath the legs, indicating the table's position on a flat surface. The artist's signature, "H.A. Marsh," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Tilt Top Table
